$comment: Step 4 voice manifest — the ONLY paid audio for Look at Bobo so far.
The game plays these as static files and never calls the API (build-a-game rule 5).
Every paid generation goes through tools/gen-audio.mjs. Nothing else touches ElevenLabs.
Texts are byte-exact game strings: 'DAG!' and 'your did it! you wind' are spelled
exactly this way ON PURPOSE (docs/DECOY_CAT.md, VISION.md). gen-audio.mjs refuses to
generate anything whose text drifted from the strings in docs/VOICES.md.
ISSUE #96 (2026-11-17): casting moved Liam -> Jessica (female, 'Playful, Bright, Warm',
on this account's own GET /v1/voices list) for all three lines, and the win line gained
speakText: the SPOKEN 'wind' must sound like a breeze ('winned', rhymes with 'pinned').
multilingual_v2 has no phoneme-tag support, so the fix is ElevenLabs' documented respell
trick applied to the generation input ONLY — 'text' stays the byte-exact display string.
Casting + settings rationale: docs/VOICES.md. Ids verified against ElevenLabs' public
GET /v1/voices list on 2026-11-14; the tool resolves by NAME at buy time anyway.

limits.$comment: Brandon pre-approved spend for exactly these lines, max 2 takes each (issue #7, 2026-11-14).

assets.title: The yell — played on every correct catch
assets.speaker: The player (first-person, unseen)
assets.delivery: A joyful, silly shout at a friend across the room — the delight of 'look look LOOK, that's my cat!'. Loud and bright, never angry, never scary.

assets.title: Wrong-cat penalty — played with the gentle X on the decoy cat
assets.speaker: The player (first-person, unseen)
assets.delivery: A playful, mock-stern 'no-no!' — comedic disappointment, the pettiest 'dag' in the world. Gentle and silly, never harsh, never a buzzer, never mean about the decoy.

context.$comment: One-word lines come out flat without context (build-a-game step 4 tip). These shape the delivery only; the billed worst case counts them (docs/VOICES.md).

assets.title: Win line — played when the score reaches 10
assets.speaker: The player (first-person, unseen)
assets.$speakTextComment: Issue #96: spoken 'wind' = a breeze (wihnd), not 'wind it up' (wynd). 'winned' rhymes with 'pinned/sinned'. Display/HUD text unchanged — respelling lives here, in the generation input, and nowhere else.
assets.delivery: Disbelieving, giddy celebration, a bit breathless and proud — like reading your own trophy plaque out loud. The mangled spelling is the joke; read 'wind' like the weather (see speakText).
